# shoal_role_binding (Resource)

Grants a role to a user, service account or group, either in one namespace or tenant-wide. You can only grant permissions you hold yourself. Bindings are immutable: any change replaces the binding. Maps to `/v1/role-bindings/{id}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Give a group the editor role in one namespace.
resource "shoal_role_binding" "payments_devs" {
  role         = "editor"
  subject_kind = "group"
  subject_id   = shoal_group.payments_devs.id
  namespace    = shoal_namespace.payments.name
}

# A tenant-wide binding (omit namespace).
resource "shoal_role_binding" "platform_admins" {
  role         = "tenant-admin"
  subject_kind = "group"
  subject_id   = shoal_group.platform_admins.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role` (String) Built-in (`tenant-admin`, `namespace-admin`, `editor`, `operator`, `viewer`) or custom role name.
- `subject_id` (String) Id of the user, service account or group, e.g. `shoal_group.sre.id`.
- `subject_kind` (String) `user` (people and service accounts) or `group`.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Namespace the role applies in. Omit for a tenant-wide binding (needed for tenant permissions such as `users:manage`). This does not default to the provider's namespace.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import shoal_role_binding.payments_devs rb_01hx...
```
